Footnote separator rules sit in different horizontal positions: roughly centre on page 87 (folio 79) and towards the left on page 88 (folio 80). On both pages the Hebrew footnote entries (96 and 97) sit at the right. This is a cosmetic inconsistency, not a misplaced note.

Page 88 (folio 80): footnote marker 97 floats about mid-measure, above the first line of 'תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד…', on the line under the Ashrei verse. Marker 96 on page 87 sits at the start of its line. Without the source I can't confirm that 97 is attached to the intended word, but it is clear, does not overlap anything, and comes before its entry at the bottom of the same page.
limitations: Only the five assigned PNGs (pages 84–88) and the manifest were reviewed. The manifest lists source_batch_pages 84–89, but page 89 was not assigned or read, so the end of this batch and any footnotes or page transition after page 88 are not covered.

I judged only the visual result from raster images at the supplied resolution. I did not check against source text, so the content of points and wording was checked only for being readable and not broken, not for being correct.
There is no English text on pages 84–88. The early English-only peace blessing and the English footnote paragraph-direction fix do not appear in this range, so this review cannot confirm them.
